name: @sutura/monorepo
description: AI agents make CI pass. Sutura verifies the fix, filters flaky failures, rejects unsafe shortcuts, and opens an evidence-backed PR for human review.
author: Juan González Ponce

scripts.test:release-contracts: pnpm --filter @sutura/core build && node --test scripts/capture-run.test.mjs scripts/captured-fixtures.test.mjs scripts/dogfood.test.mjs scripts/guards-verify.test.mjs scripts/placebo-live.test.mjs scripts/pre-push.test.mjs scripts/provider-contract-canary.test.mjs scripts/release-workflow.test.mjs scripts/release-evidence.test.mjs scripts/test-candidate-install.test.mjs scripts/test-external-matrix.test.mjs scripts/test-public-install.test.mjs
scripts.ci:fast: pnpm run test:release-contracts && pnpm run test:readme && pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run lint && pnpm run verify:bundle && pnpm --filter sutura --filter @sutura/action test
scripts.ci:local: pnpm run test:release-contracts && pnpm run test:readme && pnpm run verify:readme-setup && pnpm --filter placebo run smoke:offline && pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run lint && pnpm run verify:bundle && pnpm run test && pnpm run test:package
